verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk copy of the portrait original: the body copy, the 'Reserve a Case' button label and 'Ships late June' are tiny and hard to read, the legal line can't be read at all, the logo is very small, and there is empty space at the bottom. B actually rearranges the layout. The dark band becomes a left panel with the logo, the headline sits on the right and the body and legal text stay readable. Its flaws: the dark panel stops partway down and leaves an awkward cream gap, the orange divider floats loose beside the logo, the body copy runs almost edge to edge with tight spacing, and the CTA pill is small for the main action.
